queries.legend: System - Processes executing in kernel mode
User - Normal processes executing in user mode
Idle - Waiting for something to happen
Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode

match.series: Idle - Waiting for something to happen
Nice - Niced processes executing in user mode
System - Processes executing in kernel mode
User - Normal processes executing in user mode

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory usage breakdown

queries.legend: Inactive - Memory not recently accessed, can be reclaimed
Active - Memory currently being used by a process
Cache - Memory being used to cache data, can be freed immediately if required
Wired - Memory in use by the Kernel
Free - Completely unused memory available for allocation

match.series: Active - Memory currently being used by a process
Inactive - Memory not recently accessed, can be reclaimed
Wired - Memory in use by the Kernel
Free - Completely unused memory available for allocation
Cache - Memory being used to cache data, can be freed immediately if required
